attribution: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
description: Federal Reserve public FOMC meeting calendar pages: fomchistorical{YYYY}.htm (2003-2020) and fomccalendars.htm (2021 onwards), plus the 2003 schedule press release and the 2020 minutes publication page used as cross-checks
permission_basis: Public meeting schedule data published by the Board of Governors, free to use; the pages require no API key. Used for research only; raw payloads are not redistributed. This registry entry is an explicit research-use assertion, not a legal determination.
provider: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
timestamp_basis: Scheduled meeting dates are public in advance (the annual schedule is announced months ahead); the statement day is the last day of the meeting and the statement is released at about 14:00 ET on that day.
